items: portable power station or home battery sized in kWh and kW
why: ChatGPT's answer is purely a sizing table and formula (1–2 kWh for Wi-Fi and lights up to 20–40+ kWh for whole-house with AC), names no accessory or second product the shopper must add, and closes by asking whether they want one whole-home battery or one portable power station. The deciding fact is matching both capacity (kWh for runtime) and continuous output (kW for the appliances' load) in one unit, which is a single-product comparison across sizes rather than a set.
